p: Joshua called the Reubenites: After that the Israelites enjoyed the land of Canaan.
commanded you: Which was to go armed before their brethren, Nu 32:29.
love the LORD your God: He shows where fulfilling the Law consists.
blessed them: He commended them to God, and prayed for them.
brethren: Who remained at home and did not go to the war, Nu 31:27; 1Sa 30:24.
there an altar by Jordan: That is, beyond Jordan: for sometime the whole country on both sides of Jordan is referred to as Canaan.
to war against them: Such was their zeal, that they would rather lose their lives, that allow the true religion to be changed or corrupted.
the whole congregation of the LORD: Not only of the princes, but also of the common people.
cleansed until this day: Meaning, God is not fully pacified, in that no punishment can be sufficient for such wickedness and idolatry.
rebel not against the LORD: To use any other service than God has appointed is to rebel against God, 1Sa 15:23.
perished not alone in his iniquity: Signifying, that if many suffered for one man's sin, for the fault of many, all should suffer.
himself require it: Let him punish us.
cease from fearing the LORD: Or, to turn back from the true God.
generations in time to come: They signify a wonderful care that they bore toward their posterity, that they might live in the true service of God.
among us: By preserving and governing us.
delivered the children of Israel out: Whom if ye had offended; he would have punished with you.
